record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: GOLDEEN (1 star) and SEAKING (2 stars), the queued units.
record.summary: Self-only effect, no damage and no target. In order the caster (1) requests a shield of 50 (GOLDEEN, 1 star) or 100 (SEAKING, 2 stars) through pokemon.addShield(shield, pokemon, 1, crit), (2) calls status.clearNegativeStatus(caster, caster) and (3) calls board.clearBoardEffect on its own current cell with no specific effect, clearing every board effect there. The shield amount is the REQUESTED value: the entity method first multiplies a positive value by 1.25 rounded down when the caster holds a Big Eater Belt, then the state method multiplies by (1 + AP/100) (apBoost 1), by critPower on a crit, by 0.5 when the caster is enraged, rounds, and adds it to the current shield (floor 0), only if the caster's hp > 0. addShield is not healing: Protect (status.protect), wound and Rune Protect do not appear in it (shared references: core-mechanics section J4 for the addShield path, J2 for what handleHeal guards). clearNegativeStatus zeroes the cooldowns of burn, silence, fatigue, poison, freeze, sleep, confusion, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, armor reduction, locked and blinded, clears curse (and adds 2000 ms to a running curse cooldown instead of zeroing it) and zeroes the possession cooldown unless the caster is possessed (the origin passed is the caster itself, so origin.team === entity.team always holds and ANY active possession keeps its cooldown); the boolean flags themselves drop on each status's next update. The status cleansing and the board-effect clear are separate mechanisms: clearBoardEffect removes EVERY board effect registered on the caster's own cell (harmful or helpful) from the cell and from the caster's effects set, whereas clearNegativeStatus touches neither effects nor the boolean flags. Executed (stand-in units): order shield -> clearNegativeStatus -> clearBoardEffect; shield 50 / 100 (AP 100 or a crit doubles it, Belt 62, enraged 25, hp 0 -> 0); the 14 cooldowns zero while burn / poison / paralysis flags and 3 poison stacks stay set; curse cooldown 3000 -> 5000; an active possession keeps its cooldown. The cast needs no target.

targeting.who: the caster only (shield, status clearing, own cell's board effects)

geometry.shape: self; one board cell (the caster's current position)

effects.scaling: addShield with apBoost 1: requested value, then (entity) Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down for a positive value, then (state) x(1 + AP/100), x critPower on a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false), x0.5 if the caster is enraged, Math.round
effects.resolution: applied change: shield = max(0, shield + round(value)), only when the caster's hp > 0 (otherwise nothing is added); shieldDone is credited to the caster. Requested (50 / 100) versus applied (after Belt, AP, crit, enraged halving, rounding) differ whenever one of those applies. Not subject to the heal guards: Protect, wound and Rune Protect do not block a shield. The shield later absorbs damage inside handleDamage (core-mechanics section J1); no timer on the shield was found in this strategy.

statusEffects.status: clearNegativeStatus (burn, silence, fatigue, poison, freeze, sleep, confusion, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, armor reduction, curse, possessed, locked, blinded)
statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the shield, before the board-effect clear
statusEffects.guards: no Rune Protect check and no immunity check: the method writes cooldowns directly. It sets cooldowns to 0 and the curse flag to false; a running curse cooldown gets +2000 ms instead of being zeroed ('do not clear curseCooldown on purpose'); the possession cooldown is zeroed unless the unit is possessed: the origin passed here is the caster itself, so origin.team === entity.team always holds and ANY active possession keeps its cooldown. It does not set the boolean flags (burn, paralysis, ...) or poisonStacks: each flag falls when its update function next sees cooldown - dt <= 0 (e.g. confusion and armor reduction on the next update; poison stacks reset at the end of updatePoison, after that call's poison damage block) so the cleansing is effective at the caster's next status update, not instantly inside the cast. Positive statuses are untouched.
statusEffects.combatEffect: not traced beyond the removal of the listed statuses on the next update; the effect of each negative status is described in the ability records that apply it.

shields.note: see effects[0]; requested, then applied after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged halving and rounding

starBehavior.note: shield indexed by the caster's stars (pokemon.stars - 1), fallback 300; the 3-star and 4-star entries (150 / 300) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes. The status clear and the board-effect clear do not depend on stars. maxPP 100 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: The board-effect clear uses the caster's own x / y at cast time: any board effect on that cell is removed (and removed from whichever entity stands there, which is the caster). No range or target condition.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept; each cast adds another shield on top of the existing one. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: shield 50 / 100 on the caster. Applied: round(floor(1.25 x value if Big Eater Belt) x (1 + AP/100) x critPower-if-crit x 0.5-if-enraged) added to the current shield, only when hp > 0. Negative statuses: cooldowns zeroed at cast, flags drop on the next status update. Board effects on the caster's cell: all cleared. No damage, heal, PP gain or stat change is requested; Twist Band does not appear in addShield.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, canCast); with requiresTarget false it can cast without a target, but the exact trigger rules in AttackingState were only read at the PP gate
Crit resolution (only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was read)
How shield absorption interacts with later damage modifiers (see core-mechanics section A / J1); not re-traced here
Which board effects exist on a cell and what the cleared effects do were not traced
unresolved: Consulted: WaterfallStrategy, AbilityStrategy.process, castAbility, PokemonEntity.addShield, PokemonState.addShield, applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff, Status.clearNegativeStatus and the update functions of confusion, poison and armor reduction, Board.clearBoardEffect, core-mechanics section J. The queue record lists no routing uncertainties.

Read in this recheck: the update functions of burn (healBurn), fatigue, poison, confusion, armor reduction, blinded and possession (a flag drops when cooldown - dt <= 0); the silence, freeze, sleep, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, locked and curse updates were not individually read and are assumed to clear their flag the same way.
A shield on a dead (hp <= 0) caster is skipped; whether the cast can occur then was not traced.

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (addShield, Status.clearNegativeStatus, Board.clearBoardEffect) and the real WaterfallStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_C4); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in units and board): the call order, the shield values, the cooldown zeroing with flags and poison stacks kept, the curse cooldown +2000, the possession keep, and the removal of every board effect on the own cell only.
